label: N-50
map_notes: Parcel 50 is not a single flat 3-storey block. The Pervititch crop shows a small rectangular right/rear open void and a height/roof change: the north street mass reads as the taller 3-storey part, while the south/rear part reads lower, about 2 storeys. Model it as one L-plan building group with two touching volumes and different roofs, not as a separate grey box.

zones.description: Taller north/front masonry mass for the numbered 50 entrance.
Lower south/rear wing wrapping the rectangular open lightwell.

open_questions: The exact handwritten height abbreviation on N-50 remains soft in the raster, but the visible map geometry supports a clear lower rear piece and a separate taller front piece.

resolved_assumptions.l_plan: The right/rear rectangular lightwell is cut from the N-50 mass, so the visible footprint reads as an L plan.
resolved_assumptions.height_step: User/map reread takes priority over the old single 3-storey interpretation: model the rear wing as lower than the north/front mass.
resolved_assumptions.not_extra_building: The lightwell is open space, not a detached grey building.
